written.headline: OpenAI countersues Apple over trade secrets and supplier threats
written.summary: OpenAI filed a countersuit against Apple in a California court, accusing the iPhone maker of stealing trade secrets and coercing shared suppliers. The legal action escalates an ongoing dispute between the two companies over former employees and hardware development.

written.headline: AI researchers debate odds of intelligence explosion before 2029
written.summary: AI researchers Ege Erdil of Google DeepMind and Daniel Kokotajlo of the AI Futures Project discussed their timelines for an intelligence explosion on the Dwarkesh Podcast. Erdil put the odds of a software-only intelligence explosion before 2029 at 10 to 20 percent, while Kokotajlo placed them above 50 percent.
